title: Sparkly wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='band' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8b5cf6'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#6d28d9'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='metal' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fde68a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f59e0b'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- top band -->
  <rect x='44' y='4' width='12' height='24' rx='4' fill='url(#band)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='4' width='5' height='24' rx='2' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <!-- bottom band -->
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='12' height='24' rx='4' fill='url(#band)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='5' height='24' rx='2' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <!-- buckle -->
  <rect x='43' y='88' width='14' height='6' rx='2' fill='url(#metal)'/>
  <!-- lugs -->
  <rect x='42' y='24' width='16' height='6' rx='2' fill='url(#metal)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='70' width='16' height='6' rx='2' fill='url(#metal)'/>
  <!-- case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='23' fill='url(#metal)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='19' fill='#1e293b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='19' fill='none' stroke='#38bdf8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- ticks -->
  <rect x='49' y='33' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#7dd3fc'/>
  <rect x='49' y='63' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#7dd3fc'/>
  <rect x='33' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#7dd3fc'/>
  <rect x='63' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#7dd3fc'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <rect x='49' y='38' width='2' height='13' rx='1' fill='#fef9c3'/>
  <rect x='50' y='48' width='11' height='2' rx='1' fill='#fde68a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#fbbf24'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fef08a'>
    <path d='M14 20 L16 25 L14 30 L12 25 Z'/>
    <path d='M10 25 L14 26 L10 27 Z'/>
    <path d='M18 25 L14 26 L18 27 Z'/>

    <path d='M80 20 L85 21 L80 22 Z'/>
    <path d='M90 20 L85 21 L90 22 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 78 L82 83 L80 88 L78 83 Z'/>
    <path d='M76 83 L80 84 L76 85 Z'/>
    <path d='M84 83 L80 84 L84 85 Z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#67e8f9'>
    <path d='M20 68 L21.5 72 L20 76 L18.5 72 Z'/>
    <path d='M26 74 L30 75.5 L26 77 Z'/>
    <path d='M86 55 L87.5 59 L86 63 L84.5 59 Z'/>
    <path d='M13 48 L14.5 51 L13 54 L11.5 51 Z'/>

</svg>
